caption:
Your photos may show where you live 📍

Photos can carry hidden EXIF data: GPS location, camera model and the date taken. Check it before you post or send.

1️⃣ Open image.315tools.com and choose Remove EXIF
2️⃣ See what's hidden in your photo
3️⃣ Save a clean copy with the same quality

Your photo stays on your device the whole time.
